titulo: Quiz — Ask the question whose answer fits in your head
introPt: A traveller shrinks a three-street answer into one usable move.
cenario: On a street corner, looking for a pharmacy.

dialogo.pt: Is there a pharmacy near here?

dialogo.es: Sì, prende la seconda a destra, poi sempre dritto fino alla chiesa.
dialogo.pt: Yes, take the second right, then straight on to the church.
Can you show me on the map?

perguntas.pergunta: Why open with c'è instead of dov'è?
opcoes: The answer is yes or no, which fits in your head
perguntas.explica: Ask the question whose answer you can actually carry.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the cash machine called in Italy?
perguntas.explica: The same word also covers the debit card.

perguntas.pergunta: You lost the middle of a long answer. What do you do?
opcoes: Ask them to repeat the whole thing
The plural of c'è, which travel rarely needs
perguntas.explica: Almost every travel question is singular — learn c'è properly.

perguntas.pergunta: Destra, sinistra, sempre dritto — what is your job with these?
opcoes: Recognise them; your production job is shrinking the answer
